# Test files verified safe to share a worker (Vitest isolate: false).
#
# Used only by vitest.hybrid.config.ts / `pnpm test:hybrid`. Every other unit
# file, and every file here under `pnpm test`, still runs isolated: the isolated
# suite remains the CI/handoff authority (AGENTS.md, docs/plans/slow-test-suite.md).
#
# Admission rule: a file is listed only after the whole set ran unisolated and
# shuffled (files and tests) with no failure across at least 10 consecutive runs
# on distinct seeds and 3-8 workers. A file that ever fails unisolated is
# removed and stays out; do not re-add it without fixing the leak. Verified
# 2026-10-08: 483 candidates from vitest.lane.safe.txt, 9 leaked (provider
# registry, menus, pricing, approval coordinator) and were removed, then the
# remaining 474 passed 16 consecutive runs (seeds 11..16193, workers 3-8).
#
# Growth attempt 2026-10-08 (scripts/test-impact/verify-shared.mjs grow): of 178
# further candidates, 19 passed 10 clean rounds in batches, but the 493-file union
# then failed non-interactive.test.ts at round 6 of 12 while this 474-file set
# passed 12/12. A leak that only shows in some orderings means 10 rounds is too
# few for a large pool; the gain was ~19 files, so none were admitted. Excluded
# in that run: Banner, SettingsMenuSession, menu-bindings-parity (and 3 others).
#
# Files not listed here are never run unisolated, including new files.
